import numpy as np, itertools
def rat_fit(dp, dq, extra=None):
    tgt=-sigma/eps
    Pm=[eps**i*T**j for i in range(dp+1) for j in range(dp+1-i)]
    Pn=[eps**i*T**j for i in range(dq+1) for j in range(dq+1-i) if (i,j)!=(0,0)]
    # tgt*(1+sum q m) = sum p m  -> sum p m - tgt*sum q m = tgt
    A=np.column_stack(Pm+[-tgt*m for m in Pn])
    w=1/np.abs(tgt)  # weight
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A*w[:,None],tgt*w,rcond=None)[0]
    p=c[:len(Pm)]; q=c[len(Pm):]
    pred=(A@c)
    # evaluate true model
    num=sum(pi*m for pi,m in zip(p,Pm)); den=1+sum(qi*m for qi,m in zip(q,Pn))
    s_pred=-eps*num/den
    r=sigma-s_pred
    return np.mean(r**2)/np.var(sigma)
for dp in [1,2,3]:
    for dq in [1,2,3]:
        print(dp,dq,rat_fit(dp,dq))

def rat_coef(dp,dq):
    tgt=-sigma/eps
    Pm=[(i,j) for i in range(dp+1) for j in range(dp+1-i)]
    Pn=[(i,j) for i in range(dq+1) for j in range(dq+1-i) if (i,j)!=(0,0)]
    A=np.column_stack([eps**i*T**j for i,j in Pm]+[-tgt*eps**i*T**j for i,j in Pn])
    w=1/np.abs(tgt)
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A*w[:,None],tgt*w,rcond=None)[0]
    print("P",[(k,round(v,4)) for k,v in zip(Pm,c[:len(Pm)])])
    print("Q",[(k,round(v,4)) for k,v in zip(Pn,c[len(Pm):])])
